cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.
